payloads.description: Baseline valid address payload

browser executes injected payload (fetch callback observed on controlled callback endpoint) when viewing address in UI

test_cases.notes: Start with benign baseline. Use unique marker and low-frequency probing. Do not escalate payloads beyond probe without confirmation.

payloads.description: Baseline add-to-basket request

payloads.description: Baseline checkout request for own basketId
Probe attempting checkout on other basketId path (replace path id)

payloads.description: Baseline valid login attempt
Multiple safe invalid attempts to detect rate limits or throttling

prerequisites.description: No auth required for initial login; CSRF token requirement unknown — capture if present
prerequisites.custom_logic: If login form includes CSRF token, extract and include in payload

oracle_rules.condition: Observe response time increases > baseline + 3000ms indicating throttling
Different status codes (200 vs 401 vs 429) observed between valid, invalid and blocked attempts

test_cases.notes: Respect rate limits. Use low-frequency invalid attempts to detect throttling. Stop if IP is blocked.

payloads.description: Baseline export request

payloads.description: Baseline delete own item (if exists) - ensure safe target

test_cases.notes: Avoid deleting real user data. Use probe ids that are safe and owned by tester.

payloads.description: Baseline request as admin (if available)

oracle_rules.condition: Non-admin vs admin response codes compared (expect 200 for admin, 401/403 for non-admin). If non-admin receives 200, flag as authz bypass.

test_cases.notes: Compare admin and non-admin authenticated sessions. Do not attempt privilege escalation.

global_prerequisites.description: Standard authentication: form_login observed; capture session cookie or Authorization bearer token from /rest/user/login

execution_hints.value: Respect individual test max_requests. Insert delays (1-3s) between sensitive probes. Monitor for 429 responses and back off.
CSRF token presence unknown for some endpoints. Capture tokens from forms or JS prior to state-changing requests if present.
Provide external callback endpoint for XSS payloads to detect execution (e.g., /__probe).
